name: Renderer QA: minimal
_note: Level 0 of the progressive matrix, and the scene the reference renderer is compared against: opaque geometry, one camera, nothing else. Everything absent here is absent on purpose -- no transparency, no skinning, no particles, no water, no terrain, no sky. A difference between two renderers on this scene cannot be blamed on a subsystem, because there is only one. The kinds are `orb`, deliberately: an orb is a plain mesh entity, while a `procedural` node becomes a GPU-generated instance set that a minimal path has no business reproducing.

nodes.name: static-object
nodes._note: Phase 2.3's STATIC_TEST_OBJECT, at its documented (10, 2, -20) with a non-identity rotation and a non-uniform scale, so a lost or re-derived TRS cannot look correct by accident.
